Young Hero: 
       Long time no see. How have you been? 
       Thanks to you, the stall is doing great. Your Auntie hasn't been this happy in ages—she smiles chatting with customers all day, and even dances a few steps when the Pipa lady plays! When it's slow, Old Zhang and Old Yao even try to race the lads from the deity competition team, haha. 
      Everyone at Tianshui Market speaks of your chivalry. We are happy to hear it and miss you often. Your Auntie worries you aren't eating well or staying warm, she talks about you all the time. Come visit the stall when you can. 
      Oh, we made some money from the scalding vegetable stall, so we thought we'd help others out. We sent some food to a few old partners. We were afraid they'd feel embarrassed, so we said it was from you. They were surprised a kind hero remembered them! Old Zhang said, "That child is just warm-hearted like that!" They were shy, so they wrote you notes. Take a look. 
      Okay, customers are coming. I'll stop here. 
      Stay warm, fed, and safe out there.
